description: Hardware abstraction layer for nRF5340 radio timing and control, including constants, inline functions for radio configuration, power management, and timing delays.

methods.name: hal_radio_stop
methods.description: Stops radio operation and clears high voltage power if used.

methods.name: hal_radio_phy_mode_get
methods.description: Determines radio PHY mode based on input parameters.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_floor
methods.description: Returns closest supported power level at or below input.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_power_high_voltage_set
methods.description: Enables high voltage request for +3dBm transmit power.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Gets TX ready delay in microseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_us_get
methods.description: Gets RX ready delay in microseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Gets TX chain delay in microseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_us_get
methods.description: Gets RX chain delay in microseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Gets TX ready delay in nanoseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_ready_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Gets RX ready delay in nanoseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_tx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Gets TX chain delay in nanoseconds based on PHY and flags.

methods.name: hal_radio_rx_chain_delay_ns_get
methods.description: Gets RX chain delay in nanoseconds based on PHY and flags.
